content: Rahul Jain contacted agent Ramesh Tiwari after noticing his policy status showed as expired. Ramesh confirmed that policy AU-45219 expired due to a failed auto-renewal payment. Ramesh provided a secure payment link for the pending premium of ₹12,450 to instantly reactivate the policy, and Rahul agreed to complete the payment.

action_items: Rahul Jain to complete the premium payment using the provided secure link
Rahul Jain to notify Ramesh Tiwari once the payment is done
